name: context-handoff
description: Transfer long-running Codex work into a fresh verified thread without losing acceptance criteria or evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Continue long Codex work in a verified fresh thread
interface.longDescription: Checkpoint a long-running Codex task, preserve its goal, acceptance criteria, evidence, workspace identity, and open risks, then continue in a fresh thread only after a destination regression sentinel passes. Unsupported surfaces fall back to a validated recovery packet.
defaultPrompt: Checkpoint this task and continue it in a fresh verified thread.
Prepare a safe handoff packet for this long-running Codex task.
Check context health and hand off only if a fresh thread is warranted.
